description: ALKIS Straßenschlüssel is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The list of street names includes the districts and district-free cities, the municipalities and the streets of the municipality as names and keys. The data is currently derived from the Official Property Registry Information System (ALKIS) and is available as a nationwide database. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "ALKIS Road Keys" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include AdVMIS, Open Data, GDIMRH, opendata. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
